title: Fields and Waves
objectives:
Deep Understanding of Electromagnetic Wave Propagation and Transmission using Transmission Lines
and Waveguides.
syllabus:
Maxwell’s Equations
Boundary Conditions, Time-Varying Potentials, Maxwell’s Equations and Plane Waves, The Wave
Equation in Three Dimensions, Power Flow in Electromagnetic Fields-Poynting’s Theorem, Poynting’s
Theorem for Phasors, Penetration of Electromagnetic Fields into a Good Conductor, Internal Impedance of
a Plane Conductor, Power Loss in a Plane Conductor, The Retarded Potentials as Integrals over Charges
and Currents, The Electromagnetics of Circuits, Skin Effect and Internal Impedance, Calculation of Circuit
Elements.
Plane Wave Propagation and Reflection
Uniform Plane Waves in a Perfect Dielectric, Polarization of Plane Waves, Waves in Imperfect Dielectrics
and Conductors, Plane Waves Normally Incident on Discontinuities, Reflection of Normally Incident
Plane Waves from Perfect Conductors, Transmission-Line Analogy of Wave Propagation: The Impedance
Concept, Normal Incidence on a Dielectric, Plane Waves Obliquely Incident on Discontinuities, Incidence
at Any Angle on Perfect Conductors, Phase Velocity and Impedance for Waves at Oblique Incidence,
Incidence at Any angle on Dielectrics, Total Reflection, Polarizing or Brewster Angle, Multiple Dielectric
Boundaries with Oblique Incidence.
Transmission Lines
Voltage and Current Distribution Along an Ideal Transmission Line, Relation of Filed and Circuit Analysis
of Transmission Lines, Reflection and Transmission at a Resistive Discontinuity, Reflection and
Transmission Coefficients and Impedance and Admittance Transformations for Sinusoidal Voltages,
Standing-Wave Ratio, The Smith Transmission-Line Chart, Impedance Matching, Non-Ideal Transmission
Lines, Power Loss and Attenuation in Low-Loss Lines, Input Impedance and Quality Factor for Resonant
Transmission Lines, Group and Energy Velocities.
Waveguides
Rectangular Waveguides, TE and TM waves, Parallel–plate waveguide, Circular Waveguides,
Characteristic Wave Impedance, Field Lines in Waveguides, Excitation of Waveguides, Microstrip Lines.
textbooks:
1- S. Ramo, J. R. Whinnery, and T. Van Duzer, Fields and Waves in Communication Electronics,
3rd ed. John Wiley & Sons, 1994.
2- U. S. Inan, A. Inan, and R. Said, Electromagnetic Engineering and Waves, 2nd ed. Prentice
Hall, 2014.
